description: This file defines the `GatewayRequest` class, which models a payment request for the eWay third-party payment gateway. It handles various request types (Real-time, CVN, Beagle, Refund), constructs XML representations of requests, and provides setters/getters for payment data fields.

classes.name: GatewayRequest
classes.description: A class representing a payment request to the eWay payment gateway, encapsulating request parameters, request type, and XML serialization.

methods.name: getUrl
methods.description: Returns the appropriate request URL based on the request type and mode.

methods.name: toXml
methods.description: Constructs an XML string representing the current state of the request, suitable for sending to the gateway.

methods.name: createNode
methods.description: Helper method to create XML nodes as strings.
